title: TIC quarterly U.S. gross external debt (as-of 2026-06-30) — the ordinary edition that publishes the year's most provisional quarter
source: TSY: home.treasury.gov/data/treasury-international-capital-tic-system/release-dates-of-tic-data, re-fetched direct by THIS event's own session 2026-09-09 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 111,182 bytes) — its 2026 table's September row reads '16 | 16 | 30' across the monthly / quarterly-nonfinancial / gross-external-debt columns, under 'All data releases occur at 4 p.m. Washington, D.C. time'. The same page's note block states the rule in Treasury's own words: 'Quarterly U.S. Gross External Debt. The time of release is normally at 4:00 p.m. in Washington D.C. The release dates are the last business day of each quarter (March, June, September, and December).' notes: WHAT IT PUBLISHES: the U.S. gross external debt position as-of 2026-06-30, on a one-quarter lag, at 16:00 ET with no accompanying press release. An ORDINARY (non-June) edition, so on this series' own record it adds exactly one new as-of quarter and revises nothing: 52 of 52 revisions in the stamped archive carry a June stamp, zero March, zero September, zero December (this session's independent census; the sibling ledger's own count is 66 of 66 over a slightly wider vintage set, same 100% attribution). THE FINDING THAT IS THIS EVENT'S OWN: the as-of Q2 quarter it publishes is the most provisional of the four. Q2 is the hardest-revised quarter in the archive — largest single revision in 7 of 14 June editions (binomial p=0.038 against 1/4), median revision 1.436% of level against 0.521% for the other three quarters (permutation p=0.011 on medians). Its mechanism is NOT the end-June securities survey, which is the natural explanation and fails two ways: |delta debt-securities| is flat across quarters (Q2 $36.2bn vs Q3 $64.6bn, permutation p=0.67) and the securities share of the Q2 revision is the LOWEST of the four (median 0.121). The Q2 concentration sits in Other Sectors — mean |delta| $335.6bn in Q2 against $167.8bn elsewhere — i.e. the non-bank loans/deposits/trade-credit side. Impact LOW and symbols empty on the standing grounds: 16:00 ET is after the equity cash close, the data is a quarter stale, no house playbook is macro-keyed. CORRIDOR: 44 tracked events sit within +/-5 days, including a `high` PCE print and the FY2027 funding deadline on this same date — but that deadline is ALREADY RESOLVED (CR enacted 2026-09-02 as PL 119-103, funding through 2026-12-11), so no lapse touches this release. THE LAPSE RISK MOVED TO DECEMBER: cr-expiry-2026-12-11 falls 20 days before the 2026-12-31 edition, and December is the only month in this series with genuine lateness.
